# `foxglove episodes get`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](episodes.md)

```text
Get an episode

Usage: foxglove episodes get [OPTIONS] <EPISODE_ID>

Arguments:
  <EPISODE_ID>


Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --format <FORMAT>
          Render output in table, JSON, or CSV format

          [default: table]
          [possible values: table, json, csv]

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --include-recordings[=<INCLUDE_RECORDINGS>]
```
